name: Do I need to pack up my smoke-damaged clothing myself, or will the professionals handle it?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to pack up my smoke-damaged clothing myself, or will the professionals handle it?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a professional smoke damage restoration company, you typically do not need to pack up your smoke-damaged clothing yourself. Most reputable services include content manipulation and inventorying as part of their restoration process. Trained technicians will carefully pack out affected items, create a detailed inventory, and transport them to a specialized facility for cleaning. This ensures items are handled correctly and prevents further contamination or damage during transport.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals typically handle packing, inventorying, and transporting smoke-damaged clothing to their facility, so you usually don't need to do it yourself.
